title: Dominican Order

questions.q: How did English Dominican mysticism differ from European Dominican mysticism?
questions.answer: European Dominican mysticism tended to concentrate on ecstatic experiences of union with the divine, while English Dominican mysticism's ultimate focus was on a crucial dynamic in one's personal relationship with God.

questions.q: What was the ultimate focus of English Dominican mysticism?
questions.answer: A crucial dynamic in one's personal relationship with God.

triples.o: a crucial dynamic in one's personal relationship with God

questions.q: What was the essential moral imitation in English Dominican mysticism?
questions.answer: An essential moral imitation of the Savior as an ideal for religious change, and as the means for reformation of humanity's nature as an image of divinity.

questions.q: What were the four elements of English Dominican mysticism?
questions.answer: First, spiritually it emulated the moral essence of Christ's life. Second, there was a connection linking moral emulation of Christ's life and humanity's disposition as images of the divine. Third, English Dominican mysticism focused on an embodied spirituality with a structured love of fellow men at its center. Finally, the supreme aspiration of this mysticism was either an ethical or an actual union with God.

questions.q: What audio issue does the third-generation iPod have?
questions.answer: The third-generation iPod has a weak bass response due to undersized DC-blocking capacitors combined with low-impedance consumer headphones forming a high-pass filter.

questions.q: What causes the weak bass response in the third-generation iPod?
questions.answer: The combination of undersized DC-blocking capacitors and the typical low-impedance of most consumer headphones forms a high-pass filter that attenuates low-frequency bass output.

triples.o: undersized DC-blocking capacitors and low-impedance consumer headphones forming a high-pass filter

questions.q: Do fourth-generation iPods have the same bass response problem?
questions.answer: Similar capacitors were used in the fourth-generation iPods, so the problem is similar.

questions.q: How can the weak bass response of the third-generation iPod be reduced or masked?
questions.answer: The problem is reduced when using high-impedance headphones and is completely masked when driving high-impedance (line level) loads, such as an external headphone amplifier.

triples.o: high-impedance headphones or high-impedance line level loads such as an external headphone amplifier

questions.q: What output stage does the first-generation iPod Shuffle use?
questions.answer: The first-generation iPod Shuffle uses a dual-transistor output stage rather than a single capacitor-coupled output.

questions.q: Does the first-generation iPod Shuffle exhibit reduced bass response?
questions.answer: No, the first-generation iPod Shuffle does not exhibit reduced bass response for any load.

questions.answer: Emperor Ai of Tang was the young son of Emperor Zhaozong, installed by Zhu Wen in 904, deposed in 907, and poisoned to death a year later.

questions.q: When did the Tang dynasty end?

questions.answer: The term may have been a combined reference to the Swiss politician Besançon Hugues and the religiously conflicted nature of Swiss republicanism in his time, using a derogatory pun on the name Hugues by way of the Dutch word Huisgenoten (housemates), referring to connotations of the German Eidgenosse (Confederates).

questions.q: What was the Confederate Party in Geneva?
questions.answer: The Confederate Party was so called because it favoured independence from the Duke of Savoy through an alliance between the city-state of Geneva and the Swiss Confederation; Besançon Hugues was a leader of it.
